sas: PROC SORT DATA=adlb OUT=adlb_sorted; BY USUBJID PARAMCD VISITNUM; RUN;
PROC MEANS DATA=adlb N MEAN STD MIN MAX; CLASS TRTA PARAMCD; VAR AVAL; RUN;
DATA adsl_adlb; MERGE adsl(IN=a) adlb(IN=b); BY USUBJID; IF a AND b; RUN;
PROC FREQ DATA=adae; TABLES TRTA*AEDECOD / CHISQ; WHERE TRTEMFL='Y'; RUN;
DATA adlb_chg; SET adlb; BY USUBJID PARAMCD; IF FIRST.PARAMCD THEN base=AVAL; RETAIN base; CHG=AVAL-base; RUN;
DATA adlb_flag; SET adlb; IF AVAL > 100 THEN ANRHI='HIGH'; ELSE IF AVAL < 10 THEN ANRHI='LOW'; ELSE ANRHI='NORMAL'; RUN;
PROC TRANSPOSE DATA=adlb OUT=adlb_wide PREFIX=VISIT; BY USUBJID PARAMCD; VAR AVAL; ID VISITNUM; RUN;
DATA adlb_last; SET adlb; BY USUBJID PARAMCD; IF LAST.PARAMCD; RUN;
